item.name: Gets all recipient field definitions for a user for a specified currency and a country.

request.name: Gets all recipient field definitions for a user for a specified currency and a country.

description.content:
Sample request:
            
    GET /recipients/fields/AU/GBP
            
\
Required user rights:
            
    CanAccessRecipients
            
\
<details><summary>**Names and descriptions for the fields that can be returned**</summary>
*   ibanOrAccountNumber - Used if either an IBAN, or an domestic Account Number can be provided.
*   accountNumber - Account Number (Domestic - with respect to the Bank Address Country Code) for the recipient's bank account.
*   iban - International Bank Account Number for the recipient's bank account.
*   nationalClearingCode - National Clearing Code for the recipient's bank.
*   bankAccountType - The type of bank account. (NOTE: is looking for an integer value that should map to the values stored for each type, e.g. 10 for Savings)
*   bankBic - Bank Identification Code for the recipient's bank.
*   bankName - Name of the bank for the recipient's account.
*   bankAddressLine1 - Line 1 of the address for the recipient's bank.
*   bankAddressLine2 - Line 2 of the address for the recipient's bank.
*   bankAddressLine3 - Line 3 of the address for the recipient's bank.
*   bankAddressCountryCode - Country code for the recipient's bank.
*   accountName - Name of the recipient on their bank account.
*   email -  Email for the recipient.
*   addressLine1 - Line 1 of the address for the recipient.
*   addressLine2 - Line 2 of the address for the recipient.
*   addressCountryCode - Country code of the address for the recipient.
*   paymentReference - Client specified reference when making payments to the recipient.
*   intermediaryBankNationalClearingCode - National Clearing Code for an intermediary bank.
*   intermediaryBankBic - Bank Identification Code for an intermediary bank.
*   intermediaryBankName - Name of the intermediary bank.
*   intermediaryBankIbanOrAccountNumber - IBAN or Account Number for an intermediary bank.
*   intermediaryBankAddressLine1 - Line 1 of the address for an intermediary bank.
*   intermediaryBankAddressLine2 - Line 2 of the address for an intermediary bank.
*   intermediaryBankAddressLine3 - Line 3 of the address for an intermediary bank.
*   intermediaryBankAddressCountryCode - Country code for an intermediary bank.
*   purposeOfPaymentCode - Default purpose of payment code for the recipient.
*   purposeOfPaymentFreeText - Default purpose of payment free text for the recipient.
*   nickname - Nickname specified by the client.
</details>
